reviewer.basis: manual agent semantic review of supplied synthetic raw text against v4 normalized annotations
reviewer.independence: separate team agent; v3 outcomes and analysis were available, so this is not blind or human approval

method: Compared all 40 raw source/answer fragments with normalized source facts and claims.
Verified all source IDs and original claim IDs/quotes, unique quote anchors, typed operand references, modality, period, scope, conditions and negative facts.
Checked every normalization edit documented in NORMALIZATION_CHANGES.md against its raw case. No case predictions were run for this review.

caveats: PF3N-04 Saturday-only exclusivity exceeds the explicitly named no-weekday restriction if Sunday remains possible; the frozen gold-pass judgment used a more exhaustive reading. This receipt preserves the tension rather than inventing a Sunday exclusion.
Qualitative relevance, subset, evidence sufficiency and some conditional claims remain outside executable v4 reasoning and may require needs_review.
CF3N-18 remains a generic evidence gap for a cross-entity ability claim; a failure there does not establish the precise incompatibility mechanism.
Synthetic agent-authored source text is taken as supplied. Review establishes annotation fidelity, not independent truth, human endorsement or blind evaluation.
